headword: {温暖化対策|おんだんかたいさく}
gloss: global warming countermeasures; climate change measures

definitions.gloss: global warming countermeasures; climate change measures; anti-warming initiatives
definitions.explanation: Actions, policies, and technologies aimed at preventing or mitigating global warming. Encompasses both reducing greenhouse gas emissions and adapting to climate change impacts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{温暖化対策|おんだんかたいさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強化|きょうか}した→強化する：25344_kyoukasuru⟧。
examples.english: The government strengthened its global warming countermeasures.

examples.japanese: {温暖化対策|おんだんかたいさく}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{再生可能|さいせいかのう}エネルギー→再生可能エネルギー：08751_saiseikanouenerugii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{普及|ふきゅう}→普及：07592_fukyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: The spread of renewable energy is advancing as a climate change measure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{個人|こじん}→個人：02758_kojin⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦それぞれ→それぞれ：01453_sorezore⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{温暖化対策|おんだんかたいさく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Both companies and individuals are expected to work on global warming countermeasures from their respective positions.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{温暖化|おんだんか}→温暖化：04622_ondanka⟧ (warming, as in global warming) and ⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧ (countermeasures, measures). This is the standard Japanese term used in policy documents, news, and everyday discussion about addressing climate change.

The full formal phrase is {地球温暖化対策|ちきゅうおんだんかたいさく} (global warming countermeasures), but {温暖化対策|おんだんかたいさく} is the common shortened form.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {温暖化対策|おんだんかたいさく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧: to work on warming countermeasures
- {温暖化対策|おんだんかたいさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{推進|すいしん}する→推進する：17281_suishinsuru⟧: to promote anti-warming initiatives
- {温暖化対策|おんだんかたいさく}{基本法|きほんほう}: Basic Act on Global Warming Countermeasures
- {温暖化対策|おんだんかたいさく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一環|いっかん}→一環：17696_ikkan⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧: as part of warming countermeasures

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{地球温暖化|ちきゅうおんだんか}→地球温暖化：18873_chikyuuondanka⟧: global warming — the phenomenon itself
- {気候変動対策|きこうへんどうたいさく}: climate change measures — a broader term covering all climate-related actions
- {環境対策|かんきょうたいさく}: environmental measures — broader environmental protection efforts
